author: Deena Winter
title: 5 Feeding Our Future defendants found guilty, 2 acquitted in sprawling fraud case
supports: Contemporaneous courthouse reporting identifies Said Shafii Farah and Abdiwahab Maalim Aftin as the two defendants acquitted of all charges at the June 7, 2024 Feeding Our Future trial.

The article independently identifies the same five convicted defendants reported by USAO-MN: Abdiaziz Shafii Farah, Mohamed Jama Ismail, Abdimajid Mohamed Nur, Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff, and Hayat Mohamed Nur.
The article reports that the seven trial defendants faced forty-one charges overall and that the jury returned mixed verdicts across the convicted defendants.
does_not_support: Primary judicial proof of the two full acquittals; verdict forms, minute entries, or judgments remain preferable and should supersede this source when captured.
Any scheme-wide conviction or charged-defendant count after June 7, 2024.
